note: Real, observed per-call latency. Gemini 3.6-flash's default (AUTOMATIC) thinking behavior is markedly slower and more variable than Anthropic's claude-opus-5 observed in this project's prior live validation (validation/live_provider/latency.json, median ~15-20s).
note_on_variance: One single call took 144.3s even with the thinking_budget cap applied and a 180s configured timeout -- comfortably within budget but far above Anthropic's typical latency. Deployments selecting Gemini should configure a generous review.request_timeout_seconds (this session used 90-180s) rather than the 30s default, which was observed to cause spurious 504s.
